description: If the workspace has no funding, offer the complimentary Visibility Check first (socialseal_start_visibility_check). When this action returns reason funding_required with suggestedTool, it did not run: relay its text, collect what missing lists, and once the user agrees call that tool with suggestedArguments plus brand as locator, market as market and the business's own website as targetWebsiteUrl. Understand one or more videos (photo and carousel posts included), a topic, competitor, creator, Monitor finding or saved set; every brief is generated from a Study. The Study starts (or is reused) free from existing evidence. Video DNA for videos that lack it is priced first: status approval_required with price (USD, or credits for a subscription), nothing run. After the user approves, resend with maxCostUsd (USD) or approvedCredits (credits) set to that price and an idempotencyKey you keep: a retry with the same key returns the same Study and is never charged twice. Charged once, only for analysis that succeeds; price_changed shows a new price; funding_required returns a funding link; funding_required and capacity_unavailable (enrichment busy) are retried later with the same key. Approved starts return status collecting and a durable studyRef before collection; poll socialseal_get_study with that reference. A same-key retry recovers the same work, including while collecting. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

approvedCredits.description: The credit price a subscription workspace approved; omit to get the price.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended request and reuse it for retries, after a quote and after a top-up. A new key starts new billable work.

maxCostUsd.description: The USD price the user approved; omit to get the price.
